tiers.name: Foundation
tiers.narrative: Learn to check source support, correct scope and plan a bounded task. You may study modules in any order; each required outcome needs its own assessed evidence.
tiers.celebration: The required modules in this group are complete. Continue with the remaining course outcomes.

tiers.name: Builder
tiers.narrative: Practice linked execution, calculations and delivery. A successful run still needs the required learner checks and automatic assessment.
tiers.celebration: The required modules in this group are complete. Your full-course certificate still depends on all required modules.

tiers.name: Architect
tiers.narrative: Use tests, targeted recovery and an accountable capstone handoff. This group does not substitute for outcomes in the other modules.
tiers.celebration: The required modules in this group are complete. Check overall course completion for your certificate status.
